title: Elon Musk’s attempt at an AI Wikipedia hasn’t been updated in months
summary: Suggested Grokipedia edits haven’t been addressed since April, according to a report. Users on Reddit and X have wondered if Grokipedia is “dead.” Lawfare also noted that Musk’s last X post mentioning Grokipedia was from February .
